name: dwm
description: Dev Workspace Manager (DWM) — repositorio raíz del monorepo.

scripts.build:internal-deps: npm run build -w packages/core --if-present && npm run build -w packages/logger --if-present && npm run build -w packages/event-bus --if-present && npm run build -w packages/scheduler --if-present && npm run build -w packages/config --if-present && npm run build -w packages/secrets --if-present && npm run build -w packages/connections-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/ai-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/adapters --if-present && npm run build -w packages/workspace --if-present && npm run build -w packages/tooling --if-present && npm run build -w packages/profile --if-present && npm run build -w packages/project --if-present && npm run build -w packages/plugin --if-present && npm run build -w packages/backup --if-present && npm run build -w packages/restore --if-present && npm run build -w packages/migration --if-present && npm run build -w packages/verification --if-present && npm run build -w packages/status --if-present && npm run build -w packages/portable-workspace --if-present && npm run build -w packages/import-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/delivery-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/psn-adapter --if-present && npm run build -w packages/agent-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/skill-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/rule-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/knowledge-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/client-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/requirement-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/project-provisioning --if-present && npm run build -w packages/environment-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/portable-package-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/ai-creator-manager --if-present && npm run build -w packages/application-api --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:internal-deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:internal-deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:internal-deps && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
